title: The Brother's Death
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji gripped his senior brother's keepsake, discovering inside a jade pendant inscribed with the Chen family emblem, along with a line of blurred blood text—'At the end of Heavenly Secrets, Xuanhuang becomes one.'

text.content: Ling Yuan descended like a specter from the heavens, an oppressive pressure immediately engulfing the entire arena. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he knew the true trial of life and death had just begun. That pressure was like a materialized mountain, compressing the air around him to stagnation, each breath feeling like swallowing steel. Ling Yuan's aged face wore a benevolent smile, yet deep within those turbid eyes lurked a chill that froze one's marrow. 'Little Chen Ji, fear not, I merely came to take you home.' The voice was gentle as an elder calling to a younger kin, but Chen Ji distinctly sensed the other's gaze was already sizing him up like a corpse.

dialogue.content: 'Go!' Chen Nian's figure suddenly blocked before Chen Ji, his sword transforming into a stunning rainbow that directly targeted Ling Yuan's throat. His movement was swift as lightning splitting the night sky, yet Chen Ji saw clearly the resolve in his senior brother's eyes—a calm acceptance of placing life and death beyond consideration. 'Senior Brother!' Chen Ji screamed, reaching out to grab Chen Nian's robe hem, but a gentle force pushed him aside. Ling Yuan coldly laughed, his withered hand lightly waving—Chen Nian's sword light scattered like fireflies. Yet Chen Nian did not retreat a single step, instead lunging forward with even greater speed and intensity.

text.content: Blood splashed through the air. Chen Nian's body was struck by Ling Yuan's palm and hurled backward, crashing through three ancient pines before barely stabilizing. His chest was caved in, ribs completely shattered, blood gushing profusely from his mouth and nose, staining half his robe crimson. Yet he still struggled to stand, his flesh-mangled hands死死 gripping Ling Yuan's sleeve, his voice a ragged嘶哑: 'Chen Ji... run quickly... Brother... will hold them off for you!' His voice was like sand grinding through stone, each word carrying blood foam. But his gaze was utterly clear—devoid of fear, without resentment, only an almost devout firmness.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's brow slightly furrowed, seemingly somewhat surprised by Chen Nian's tenacity. He lightly shook his sleeve, and Chen Nian's body flew out like a disconnected kite. Yet the next moment, Chen Nian climbed up again, using his body to block in front of Chen Ji, obstructing Ling Yuan's path. 'Reckless ant challenging a giant tree.' Ling Yuan's voice was coldly indifferent, like crushing an ant. 'Do you truly believe, with your waste of a body, you are qualified to obstruct this old man?' Chen Nian gave a tragic laugh, spewing a large mouthful of blood, yet still stood perfectly straight: 'Qualified or not... is not for you to decide...' 'Who decides, then?' Ling Yuan's tone finally carried a hint of impatience, 'Heaven itself?'

text.content: At the moment Ling Yuan struck again, Chen Ji felt a intense burning pain surge from deep within his mind. The Tianji Record's fragment trembled violently in his Mental Sea, a blurred line of text emerging—'Senior brother has not long to live, after three breaths, his primordial spirit will be completely destroyed.' This was a warning from the Tianji Record; each premonition consumed precious Heavenly Fate Value, yet at this moment Chen Ji毫不犹豫地 burned five points of Heavenly Fate, only to see where this sliver of opportunity lay within these three breaths. However, the answer was only one—his senior brother was using his own life to buy Chen Ji these three breaths of retreat time.

dialogue.content: 'Brother, don't!' Chen Ji screamed, reaching out to grab Chen Nian. Yet Chen Nian turned his head, revealing a gentle smile to Chen Ji. That smile was like the warm sun in winter, dispelling all gloom. 'Little junior brother, I have waited for this day for a very long time.' His voice was soft as a dream. 'When Master entrusted you to me, I made a vow—no matter what happens, I would protect your safety.' His eyes glistened with tears, yet his smile was perfectly serene. 'Now... I can finally fulfill this vow.'

text.content: Before his words finished, Chen Nian suddenly turned, all his True Qi burning away at this moment. His body transformed into a dazzling brilliance, directly colliding toward Ling Yuan. That light contained all his vitality, blazing like a sun falling. 'Madman!' Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed, revealing a grave expression for the first time. He formed seals with both hands, a massive barrier condensing before him. Yet even so, Chen Nian's self-destruction still sent him flying dozens of zhang, his robe torn, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. And Chen Nian's body, within that dazzling light, slowly dissipated.

'Senior Brother—!!' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse like torn cloth, tears streaming from his eyes. He frantically rushed toward that gradually dissipating light, yet only caught a handful of emptiness. Chen Nian's figure had become scattered motes of spiritual fluorescence, drifting away on the night wind. The final words before death, however, clearly entered Chen Ji's ears: 'Little junior brother... be careful... Father he...' Before finishing, his voice abruptly stopped. From the spiritual fluorescence, a blood-soaked jade pendant slowly fell, clinking to the ground at Chen Ji's feet.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stabilized his form, seeing Chen Ji clutching that jade pendant while wailing. A cruel smile curled at the corner of his mouth. 'Touching brotherly affection.' His voice came from the Nine Abysses, carrying bone-penetrating coldness. 'Unfortunately, this changes nothing. Your senior brother's sacrifice was merely futile.' He step by step approached Chen Ji, each step like stepping on Chen Ji's heart. 'Hand over the Tianji Record obediently, and perhaps this old man may grant you a swift death.' Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his tear-stained face revealing a terrifying calm.

text.content: That calm was more frightening than anger. Ling Yuan's footsteps slightly paused, a flash of apprehension crossing his eyes. Within Chen Ji's eyes, the originally turbid Spiritual Light was凝聚、蜕变 at an unbelievable speed. The senior brother's death, parents' vengeance, the Tianji Record's destiny—all the sorrow and rage at this moment transformed into a turbulent flame, burning and boiling within Chen Ji's chest. His aura at this moment skyrocketed madly, surging from early Foundation Building directly through the Foundation Building intermediate bottleneck.

Yet this was not the end. A strange fluctuation spread from within Chen Ji—that was the Tianji Record's fragment resonating with Chen Ji's神识. The incomplete Tianji Record seemed to sense its master's sorrow and rage, actively channeling a portion of its power to him for the first time. At Chen Ji's Brow Center, a blurred rune flickered in and out of visibility—that was the sign of the Tianji Record's second page seal loosening. Simultaneously, a段 of unfamiliar memory surfaced in his mind—that was the information Chen Nian transmitted to him using his final wisp of神识 before death.

choice.prompt: Senior Brother Chen Nian exchanged his life for a sliver of opportunity for you. At this moment Ling Yuan watches covetously—how will you decide?

choices.description: In his sorrow and rage, Chen Ji chooses to fight with his life, even if crushed to pieces, he must make Ling Yuan pay the price. Extremely high risk, yet if successful will greatly enhance Reputation.
choices.visible_reward: If able to wound Ling Yuan, will shock the entire assembly
choices.risk_hint: Current Strength vastly inferior to Ling Yuan's, nine deaths one life

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely clenched his fist, the True Qi within his body surging like boiling magma. He did not retreat, instead actively rushing toward Ling Yuan, his拳风 carrying turbulent rage, striking toward the other's chest. Yet Ling Yuan merely lightly raised his hand, blocking all his attacks, counter-striking with one palm that sent Chen Ji flying dozens of zhang.

choices.description: Senior Brother's sacrifice cannot be in vain, Chen Ji chooses to endure and retreat, secretly accumulating Strength for future revenge. The most rational choice, yet the heart will endure more torment.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the stigma of fleeing from battle
choices.visible_reward: Preserve a useful body, will surely be repaid in the future
choices.risk_hint: May suffer Reputation loss, yet can preserve life

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth tightly, forcibly suppressing the overwhelming grief and anger. He took one last look at where his senior brother's form had scattered, then turned into a streak of light and fled into the night. Ling Yuan snorted coldly, about to pursue, but was blocked by an invisible barrier—the final restriction left by Chen Nian's self-detonation.

choices.text: Leave with the remains and clues
choices.description: What his senior brother's sacrifice bought was not only time for retreat, but also crucial clues about his father. Chen Ji chose to inherit his senior brother's unfinished mission and pursue the truth.
choices.visible_cost: Need time to comprehend the secrets within the Jade Pendant
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information about his father and the origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may catch up, need to find a safe place quickly

text.content: Chen Ji bent down to pick up the Jade Pendant left by his senior brother, pressing it close to his chest. The pendant was warm, as if still carrying his senior brother's final body heat. He solemnly kowtowed three times toward the direction where his senior brother had vanished, then without looking back, disappeared into the night. Behind him, Ling Yuan's thunderous roar shook the heavens, but could no longer reach his figure.

Meanwhile, from the depths of the Tianji Record Fragment, Mr. Mo's low voice spoke: 'Young master, accept my condolences. Your senior brother's sacrifice... was not accidental.' Chen Ji halted, his voice hoarse as he asked, 'What do you mean?' Mr. Mo fell silent for a moment, then slowly said, 'Chen Nian... was not your true senior brother. He was a shadow guard placed by your father to protect you before your awakening. And now that he has burned through his life to complete his mission, it is time for the young master to seek the truth himself.' Chen Ji's hand holding the Jade Pendant trembled slightly, and an overwhelming hatred surged in his heart, intertwined with an inexplicable desolation.

The night was as dark as ink as Chen Ji traveled alone through mountains and peaks. The tear stains on his face had long since dried, replaced by a maturity and determination beyond his years. The Jade Pendant left by the one who had always protected him in the guise of a senior brother... no, that person, pulsed warmly against his chest, as if telling him something. Chen Ji probed his spiritual sense into the Jade Pendant and immediately felt a familiar yet unfamiliar aura. It was his father's aura! Within the Jade Pendant was actually sealed a spiritual message, left by Chen's father before his death.

dialogue.content: 'Ji'er, if you are seeing this message, it means your father has passed from this world, and Chen Nian has completed his mission.' Chen father's voice was aged and gentle, yet carried an undeniable exhaustion, 'The Tianji Record is no ordinary object. It is one of the fragments of the Heavenly Dao's will from ancient times. When your father obtained it, he was also once bewitched by its power... but later discovered that this was merely a piece in a much larger game. The true chess player was never us from the beginning.' Chen Ji tightly gripped the Jade Pendant, his knuckles white from the force.

text.content: 'Your father exhausted his entire life yet only comprehended the first page of the Tianji Record. As for the method to unseal the second page, it lies within our homeland—the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb.' Chen father's voice grew increasingly weak, 'There, you will find clues about your sister, and understand... why our Chen family has such a profound connection to the Tianji Record.' The voice gradually faded, and the Jade Pendant's temperature also cooled. Chen Ji stood at the mountain peak, allowing the night wind to flutter his robes, yet his eyes burned with an unprecedented light.

'Father... Sister... Senior brother...' Chen Ji murmured these names, each word like a knife cutting into his heart. He slowly closed his eyes, allowing tears to fall once more. However, this time the tears were mixed not only with sorrow, but also with a resolute determination to break all bridges. He opened his eyes, his gaze blazing like torches, looking toward the dark horizon in the distance. Ling Yuan's shadow had not yet faded, and the threat of the Heavenly Eye always loomed overhead, yet the current Chen Ji was clearer than ever before.

choice.prompt: The message from his father in the Jade Pendant revealed shocking secrets about the Tianji Record. What path should Chen Ji choose next?

choices.text: Immediately head to the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb
choices.description: Father's clues point to the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb, which contains the method to unseal the second page of the Tianji Record and leads to his sister's whereabouts. There is no time to waste.
choices.visible_cost: Possible danger from unknown mechanisms and formations
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the power of the second page of the Tianji Record in advance
choices.risk_hint: The Qingqiu Ancient Tomb has long been watched by various major powers, and there will surely be experts guarding it

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate at all, immediately changing direction and racing toward the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb. In the night, his figure was like a shooting star, crossing the dark sky. Behind him, the mountain peak where his senior brother sacrificed himself gradually receded, but he knew this was only the beginning.

choices.text: First seek Su Qingyao for discussion
choices.description: The Qingqiu Ancient Tomb is extremely dangerous, and Chen Ji needs a trustworthy ally. Su Qingyao is the only one who has sensed his true identity, and perhaps she can be swayed.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and support, possibly unlocking the prerequisite for 'Shared Fate'
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's stance is still unclear, with risk of exposure

text.content: After careful consideration, Chen Ji decided to first return to the Tianqing Sect to find Su Qingyao. Although this Inner Sect Senior Fellow had always harbored doubts about him, she had never truly harmed him. If he could gain her assistance, the road ahead would be much smoother.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to obtain intelligence
choices.description: Ye Qing controls the intelligence network of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, and may know the detailed situation of the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb and the layout of various major forces.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on the Qingqiu Ancient Tomb and safe routes
choices.risk_hint: Allying with the Demonic Path may bring negative consequences, and whether Ye Qing can be completely trusted is still unknown

text.content: Chen Ji took out a black communication jade talisman from his arms—this was the contact method left from the previous cooperation with Ye Qing. He injected a wisp of divine sense into the jade talisman, and soon received a reply: 'Qingqiu Ancient Tomb, abnormal movements in three days. Be careful of Ling Yuan, he has already contacted the Xuanwu Sect.'

Chen Ji gripped his senior brother's legacy, discovering within it a jade pendant engraved with the Chen family crest, along with a line of faint bloodstained words—'The end of Heavenly Secrets, where Mystery returns to Unity.' These eight characters resembled either a cryptic code or coordinates pointing in a specific direction. He tucked the jade pendant close to his body and raised his head to gaze at the gradually brightening eastern horizon. His senior brother's sacrifice, his father's entrustment, his younger sister's whereabouts, the truth of the Tianji Record—all the clues pointed to the same location. The Qingqiu Ancient Tomb. There, danger originated, yet it might also hold the key to breaking the deadlock. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, a resolute glint flickering in his eyes.

'Senior brother, rest assured.' Chen Ji murmured, his voice hoarse yet firm. 'Your sacrifice will not be forgotten. One day, I will make Ling Yuan pay for every drop of blood.' The night wind howled past, as if responding to his vow. In the distance, from the direction of the Tianqing Sect, came bursts of bell chimes—an alarm signaling the sect's encounter with a formidable enemy. Chen Ji knew Ling Yuan would not let this matter rest, but he had already made thorough preparations in his heart. This night would surely be sleepless; when tomorrow's sun rose, he would no longer be that concealed, suppressed废物弟子—a disgraced disciple bearing blood feud and sworn to revenge, a descendant of the Chen family.

As the last glimmer of starlight faded from the horizon, Chen Ji finally stopped walking. He leaned against an ancient pine, retrieving the blood-stained jade pendant from his embrace. The Chen family crest on the jade glowed faintly in the morning light—a mark his father had personally carved. His fingertips gently traced those ancient patterns, as if sensing the residual warmth of his father. His senior brother's dying words echoed in his ears—'Be careful of Father.' What did this mean? Wasn't Father always on his side? Or... did Father discover some unspeakable secret before his death? Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, a terrible suspicion surging in his heart.

dialogue.content: At this moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded once more in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a rare gravity: 'Young master, some things, before the right time comes, this old servant cannot say more. But one thing you must remember—every page of the Tianji Record corresponds to a form of destiny. The more pages you unseal, the closer your connection to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets becomes, and the stronger the fatal backlash of fate will grow.' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: 'Does that mean... even if I find all the Tianji Record, I cannot escape the so-called fatal backlash?' Mo Xiansheng did not answer directly, only sighing faintly: 'This is the price of the Tianji Record, young master. From the moment you obtained it, it was already destined.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not ask further. He placed the jade pendant into his embrace, raising his head to gaze at the brightening horizon in the distance. The morning light pierced through the clouds, casting his face in flickering illumination. Senior brother was dead, father was dead, mother had been missing for years, younger sister had been captured by the Holy Sect—he in this world had almost nothing left to lose. Precisely because of this, he could be more fearless than anyone. Ling Yuan wanted to kill him, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets watched from the shadows, the entire cultivation world might be his enemy—so what? If it must be, he would perish together with them.

Chen Ji clenched his fist, feeling the unprecedented surge of true essence within his body. His senior brother's sacrifice had awakened his dormant bloodline power, and the Tianji Record Fragment had also unsealed a small portion of its abilities. His divine sense was more acute than before, and he could even faintly perceive spiritual energy fluctuations within dozens of miles around him. This was the Tianji Record compensating him—power traded for his senior brother's life. At this thought, Chen Ji's last trace of hesitation dissipated. He now had nothing to fear. From this moment, he would completely cast off that cowardly disguise, walking through the world with his true face. Whoever dared block his path, he would make them die.
